sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-25 21:00 and 2016-11-25 21:21, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,935.29 were made on card(s) C03633-K1 belonging to customer C03633. The activity comprised 4 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in billing region 191. Online transactions came from device profile(s) MacOS | Mac OS X 10_8_5 | chrome 49.0 | 1280x800. The purchases were placed within minutes of each other, each just below a $500 threshold, a pattern that avoids single-transaction limits. The same burst shape was found on 7 cards of 7 different customers in the preceding 30 days, indicating coordinated abuse (policy R9). The amount exceeds the $1,000 reporting threshold. Total suspicious amount: $1,935.29. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
